# Dao — Chinese Contemplative Traditions Knowledge Base

> English-language knowledge infrastructure connecting Chinese contemplative traditions, classical texts, historical scholarship, modern research, and anonymized practitioner experience — with explicit evidence classification and a structured knowledge graph. Contact: admin@daoismhub.com.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://daoismhub.com/): Entry point to the knowledge base.
- [Concepts](https://daoismhub.com/concepts/): Core concepts (individual pages via /concepts/[slug]/).
- [Practices](https://daoismhub.com/practices/): Contemplative practices (individual pages via /practices/[slug]/).
- [Texts](https://daoismhub.com/texts/): Classical texts (individual pages via /texts/[slug]/).
- [Translations](https://daoismhub.com/translations/): Text translations (individual pages via /translations/[slug]/).
- [People](https://daoismhub.com/people/): Historical and modern figures (individual pages via /people/[slug]/).
- [Timeline](https://daoismhub.com/timeline/): Historical timeline (individual pages via /timeline/[slug]/).
- [Glossary](https://daoismhub.com/glossary/): Terminology glossary (individual pages via /glossary/[slug]/).
- [Stories](https://daoismhub.com/stories/): Traditional stories (individual pages via /stories/[slug]/).
- [Research](https://daoismhub.com/research/): Modern research synthesis (individual pages via /research/[slug]/).
- [Comparisons](https://daoismhub.com/comparisons/): Comparative analyses (individual pages via /comparisons/[slug]/).
- [Problems](https://daoismhub.com/problems/): Common problems and issues (individual pages via /problems/[slug]/).
- [Tools](https://daoismhub.com/tools/): Tools and frameworks (individual pages via /tools/[slug]/).
- [Guides](https://daoismhub.com/guides/): Practical guides (individual pages via /guides/[slug]/).
- [Blog](https://daoismhub.com/blog/): Blog posts (individual posts via /blog/[slug]/).
- [Experiences](https://daoismhub.com/experiences/): Anonymized practitioner experiences.
- [Experience Patterns](https://daoismhub.com/experiences/patterns/): Recurring experience patterns.
- [Experience Questions](https://daoismhub.com/experiences/questions/): Practitioner questions.
- [Experience Notes](https://daoismhub.com/experiences/notes/): Experience notes.
- [Experience Reports](https://daoismhub.com/experiences/reports/): Experience reports.
- [Data](https://daoismhub.com/data/): Structured datasets and knowledge graph.
- [Search](https://daoismhub.com/search/): Site search.

## Sub-site

- [Dao Data](https://data.daoismhub.com/): Structured data hub (entities, relationships, sources, schemas).

## Notes

- The domain is a placeholder pending final DNS/Cloudflare Pages setup.
- Content follows explicit evidence classification; see the project's source policy and schema documentation for how claims are sourced and labeled.
- Practitioner experience is anonymized; this is informational, not medical or psychological advice.
